apiUrl.label: SAX Power API URL
apiUrl.help: Base URL of the SAX Power dashboard API.

username.label: Email address
username.help: Email address used for the SAX Power dashboard.

password.label: Password
password.help: Password used for the SAX Power dashboard.

pollInterval.label: Polling interval
pollInterval.help: Interval for retrieving live data from SAX Power.

modbusDescription.text: Modbus control is optional. The adapter continues to provide all SAX Power cloud data when this feature is disabled.

modbusControlEnabled.label: Enable Modbus control
modbusControlEnabled.help: Enable forwarding of SAX Power control commands to selected writable ioBroker Modbus states.

modbusInstance.label: Modbus instance
modbusInstance.help: Select the Modbus adapter instance containing the SAX Power control registers.

modbusChargePowerStateId.label: Charge power state
modbusChargePowerStateId.help: Select the complete writable numeric ioBroker state used to set the SAX Power charging limit. Example: modbus.1.holdingRegisters.44_Leistungsgrenzwert_für_Ladung

modbusDischargePowerStateId.label: Discharge power state
modbusDischargePowerStateId.help: Optional writable numeric ioBroker state used to set the SAX Power discharge limit.

donationText.text: If this adapter is useful to you, you can support its continued development with a voluntary PayPal contribution.
